summary: The conflict has escalated significantly with the IAEA referring Iran's nuclear file to the UN Security Council and the US preparing for potential military action. Key developments include the destruction of Iranian tankers, advances in Yemen, and ongoing operations in Gaza and Lebanon. Israel has elevated Iran as the primary theater, warning of a potential multi-front war.

sections.executive_summary: The conflict has escalated significantly with the IAEA referring Iran's nuclear file to the UN Security Council and the US preparing for potential military action. Key developments include the destruction of Iranian tankers, advances in Yemen, and ongoing operations in Gaza and Lebanon. Israel has elevated Iran as the primary theater, warning of a potential multi-front war.

points: Satellite imagery shows a surge in construction at Iran's deeply buried Pickaxe Mountain nuclear site near Natanz, believed to be a potential future enrichment or nuclear safe-haven facility. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6969)

Explosions were heard on Iran's Qeshm Island and near the Strait of Hormuz in the city of Jask, with the source and nature of the incidents remaining unknown. (Source: @presstv/206142, @Faytuks_Network/6981)

The IAEA Board of Governors referred Iran's nuclear file to the UN Security Council, citing over 200kg of highly enriched uranium that survived bombings and is stored in tunnels in Isfahan and Natanz. (Source: @mamlekate/104421)

US President Trump stated the US is not seeking negotiations with Iran, claiming 9 oil tankers were struck and more attacks are planned, while an emergency military meeting was held at the White House. (Source: @SharghDaily/182839, @VahidOnline/78304, @rodast_omiddana/80623)

The IRGC spokesman listed demands for ending the current situation, including stopping US war and threats, Israel's withdrawal from Lebanon, lifting the blockade on Yemen, releasing $24 billion in frozen assets, and halting interference in nuclear and missile programs. (Source: @VahidOnline/78299)

CENTCOM confirmed all IRGC attacks on US Navy destroyers failed, while US forces destroyed 10 Iranian oil tankers in the past week, and F-35s returned to the US from RAF Lakenheath. (Source: @shin_persian/9633, @shin_persian/9630)
The IDF Chief of Staff visited the Commando Brigade in the Upper Galilee, observing combat operations and praising the tactical excellence of Brigade 36. (Source: @New_security8200/203729)

Israel elevated Iran as the primary war theater, with Lebanon identified as the secondary theater and Yemen in the background, warning of a potential multi-front war. (Source: @New_security8200/203728)
The IDF and Shin Bet destroyed three weapon caches and a rocket launch site belonging to Hamas and PIJ in the Gaza Strip, which were used to fire rockets towards Israel. (Source: @almogboker78/18153)
Airstrikes in Khan Yunis and Gaza City killed senior Hamas military commander Ahmad, who was released in the 2011 Shalit deal. (Source: @yediotnews25/134854, @yediotnews25/134860)
The IDF issued alerts about drone incursions in northern Israel ahead of Rosh Hashanah. (Source: @idf_telegram/25101)
The IDF struck Khan Yunis and Gaza City, killing senior Hamas military commander Ahmad in an airstrike. (Source: @yediotnews25/134854, @yediotnews25/134860)
The IDF and Shin Bet destroyed three weapon caches and a rocket launch site belonging to Hamas and PIJ, containing rockets and 'Clan' weapons. (Source: @almogboker78/18153)
The IDF documented pipe insertion into the Gaza Strip. (Source: @almogboker78/18156)
Explosives were placed on a target in Bani Kiyan. (Source: @redlinkleb/41965)
A motorcycle was hit on a highway in southern Lebanon. (Source: @lelotsenzura/94340)
Artillery shelling was reported in the region. (Source: @redlinkleb/41945)
Israel identified Lebanon as the secondary theater of war after Iran, noting the connection between Hezbollah and other terror groups. (Source: @New_security8200/203728)
An oil tanker was hit by an unknown projectile 28 nautical miles southeast of Al-Faw, Iraq, with the crew safe and no environmental impact reported. (Source: @shin_persian/9634)
The UKMTO reported an incident on an oil tanker 24 miles from Ras Al Khaimah, UAE, after a projectile strike. (Source: @VahidOnline/78295)
CENTCOM confirmed IRGC attacks on US warships failed and US forces destroyed 10 Iranian tankers. (Source: @shin_persian/9633)

Yemeni Armed Forces advanced towards the western coast, capturing Hayis and causing Saudi mercenaries in Al-Mukha to flee and surrender their weapons. (Source: @naya_foriraq/89963, @naya_foriraq/89968, @naya_foriraq/89972)
A potential danger alert was issued
